a.xlink:title: plans Global reference data (same for every tenant).
tenants A customer of the SaaS. RLS: a tenant sees only its own row. Audited (V3).
end_users The tenant's customers. RLS by tenant_id.

events
PARTITION BY RANGE (occurred_at): one partition per month (events_YYYY_MM) plus events_default. Raw events are kept 90 days (V7 enforce_events_retention drops expired partitions). Row-Level Security on tenant_id. Append-only: app roles get INSERT only.
funnels A tenant-defined funnel. RLS by tenant_id.
funnel_steps Ordered steps of a funnel. No tenant_id: RLS inherits through the parent funnel.
audit_log Written only by trigger audit_row_change() on tenants, plans, subscriptions, payments. Append-only: UPDATE/DELETE raise an error, even for the owner.
agg_user_activity DERIVED. One row per user. Powers rolling 7/30-day retention (Q2). View: v_user_activity.
agg_daily_active_users DERIVED. Powers DAU + 7-day moving average (Q3). View: v_daily_active_users.
agg_daily_events DERIVED. Daily event volume per type. View: v_daily_events.
mv_daily_revenue DERIVED MATERIALIZED VIEW. Revenue by signup cohort and plan (Q4). View: v_daily_revenue.
rollup_state Bookkeeping. Retention only drops a partition after the rollups consumed it.
